routingOrder: Next reserved API/auth/provider/legacy routes and runtime assets, preserving raw method, path, query, body and upstream status
Exact /aide build route and asset inventory
Exact Astro marketing route and asset inventory
Every other path is proxied to Next and retains its status, including unknown API/help paths; never marketing fallback
knownConflicts: Astro /api/status must not override Next /api namespace; publish static status information outside /api instead.
Marketing/API docs /docs/api is separate from private /api endpoints.
Shared /brand, /locales, favicon or asset filenames require a collision manifest before publishing; Next assets take priority in the prototype.
Legacy /login redirects to localized Next /fr/login or /en/login; this remains same-host app authentication.
The staging app flag and alias do not move production root. A separate local-only HTTP gateway exists but is not wired into any deployment.

localGateway.nextOrigin: HTTP literal loopback or localhost pinned to 127.0.0.1; no path, credentials, external host or HTTPS
localGateway.forwardedHostPolicy: Validate incoming Host against loopback/bound port; remove supplied Forwarded/X-Forwarded-*; derive controlled values from socket and local origin; preserve Origin for Next CSRF
